title: Compact triangulated source component
statement: Compact source component statement as in Lean

proof.text: Take B to be PUnit in the specified object universe and each Hom to be PUnit in the specified morphism universe. The unique morphisms define composition and the preadditive structure. Every object is zero. Give B identity shifts and declare every triangle distinguished. All the pretriangulated and octahedral axioms follow from uniqueness of morphisms.
For any discrete diagram, take the sole object as its coproduct, with the unique inclusions and descents. All colimit equations follow from uniqueness of morphisms.

Take the singleton family of the sole object. Each direct sum of its Hom groups is the zero group, and its comparison with Hom into a coproduct is bijective. The family generates because every object of B is zero. Package these structures into the existential conclusion; no relation between B and A is required by this statement.

theorem grothendieckDerived_compact_source
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)] :
    ∃ (B : Type (max uA vA ((max w vH) + 1))) (cB : Category.{max w vH} B),
      letI := cB
      ∃ (zB : HasZeroObject B) (sB : HasShift B ℤ) (pB : Preadditive B),
      letI := zB
      letI := sB
      letI := pB
      ∃ aB : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor B n).Additive,
      letI := aB
      ∃ tB : Pretriangulated B,
      letI := tB
      ∃ (iB : IsTriangulated B) (sumsB : HasCoproducts.{max w vH} B),
      letI := iB
      letI := sumsB
      IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w vH} B
